description: This source file defines the 'InstanceIdentity' enum providing static properties and methods to access device and environment identifiers, such as instance ID, display name, model identifier, device family, and platform string. It uses platform-specific APIs for iOS and macOS to gather system information and manages a unique instance ID stored via UserDefaults.
